title: Implement ADR-019 kernel auto-selection heuristics (FP8/INT8) in runtime dispatch + guardrails/tests
creator: Noah Patel
content:
Context
- This is the implementation task for ADR-019 (FP8/INT8 kernel selection heuristics). Goal is to codify the selection logic into runtime dispatch so benchmark wins translate to production defaults, with safe fallbacks and tests.
- Sprint deliverable for runtime-1.22.0 behind flags, rolled out via perf canary.

References
- ADR: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-019-fp8-int8-kernel-selection-heuristics.json
- Methodology: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kernel-benchmarking-methodology-top-hosted-models.json
- Canary runbook: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/runbooks/perf-canary-rollout-for-new-kernels.json
- Related PRs (expected):
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-19863-kernel-autoselect-heuristics-for-h100-a100.json (main impl)
  - sources/github/redwood/pr-19934-metrics-tagging-model-gpu-kernel-mode.json (dimensions needed for canary/debug)
  - sources/github/redwood-model-registry/pr-233-add-fp8-int8-variants-and-default-policy-stubs.json (registry metadata)

What we’re implementing (high level)
1) Dispatch-time selection (autoselect)
- Inputs: GPU arch/SKU (H100 vs A100; compute capability), model family + known architecture metadata (hidden size, head dim, KV layout), and runtime shape regime (prefill vs decode, batch size, seq-len buckets).
- Outputs: selected kernel mode for each critical path (attention + matmul), choosing among:
  - FP8 path (preferred where supported + stable)
  - INT8 path (preferred where FP8 unsupported or perf/quality/risk dictates)
  - Baseline (FP16/BF16) fallback
- Selection must be deterministic and loggable (for benchmark reproducibility and customer support).

2) Guardrails / correctness fallbacks
- Hard shape constraints: enforce alignment + supported head_dim/hidden_size constraints from INT8/FP8 implementations; if not met, fallback to baseline.
- Capability checks:
  - FP8 only on supported GPUs / driver-CUDA combos (per runtime capability registry) with explicit allowlist.
  - INT8 gating for kernels requiring specific instruction sets / library versions.
- Safety overrides:
  - Per-model and per-region disable switches (consumed by perf-canary gating).
  - Per-shape kill switch if discovered problematic regime (must be deployable without full runtime rebuild; config-driven).
- Always-available baseline: fallback must be safe and not degrade error rates (no partial state corruption; KV cache correctness in particular).

3) Observability and debuggability
- Emit kernel_mode + selected_kernel identifiers into runtime metrics tags (model, GPU, region) to support canary comparisons.
- Add structured log line on selection at model load and first request per worker (rate-limited).
- Ensure tracing hooks can attribute TTFT/TPOT deltas to mode (tie into scheduler instrumentation work).

4) Tests
- Unit tests:
  - Selection table coverage for key GPU/model/shape regimes from ADR (golden expected decisions).
  - Guardrail behavior (unsupported shapes -> baseline; unsupported GPU -> baseline; disabled by config -> baseline).
- Integration tests (CI smoke):
  - Minimal set of representative shapes that validate correctness across FP8/INT8/baseline (hooks into ENG-7426 / CI gating work).
- Non-goals for this ticket:
  - Full perf benchmarking (tracked in ENG-7428). This ticket is about correctness + wiring + deterministic selection.

Acceptance criteria (Definition of Done)
- Autoselect logic exists in runtime dispatch and matches ADR-019 heuristics for:
  - H100: FP8 attention preferred in defined seq-len regimes; INT8 matmul where applicable; baseline fallback outside guardrails.
  - A100: INT8 matmul selection where supported; FP8 only if explicitly allowed and validated (per ADR); otherwise baseline.
- Guardrails:
  - For all unsupported shape regimes, system falls back to baseline without errors.
  - Config-driven disables work at per-model and per-shape granularity.
- Telemetry:
  - Metrics have model/gpu/kernel_mode dimensions (or equivalent) and can be queried for canary.
- Tests:
  - Unit tests for selection decisions exist and are stable.
  - CI smoke test covers correctness for FP8/INT8 for a small shape set (or this ticket ships the hooks + test definitions if CI infra is in ENG-7426).
- Documentation:
  - Inline docs on flags/config (link to runbook + ADR) updated.

Rollout plan (implementation-facing)
- Feature flags:
  - Default OFF in runtime-1.22.0 until perf canary enablement.
  - Canary cohort enabling per model + region per SRE runbook.
- Rollback triggers:
  - Automatic rollback handled by perf-canary gating; ensure dispatch reads updated config without restart where possible.

Open questions / risks
- Ensuring selection decisions don’t oscillate with scheduler-induced shape variability (prefill/decode interleaving). Proposed mitigation: bucket shapes and use conservative selection at boundaries.
- Metric cardinality: adding kernel identifiers must stay within observability budget; propose: kernel_mode (fp8/int8/baseline) + a small kernel_id enum for top kernels only.
- Quality gating: selection should not enable FP8 by default for models flagged by Applied ML (tracked separately in quantization policy doc); in code, default allowlist should be model-aware.

Activity / updates
- 2026-02-12 (Yuki): Drafted selection table for H100/A100 based on ADR-019; noted two ambiguous regimes (long-context decode, small-batch prefill). Sent to Hiro + Noah for review.
- 2026-02-15 (Hiro): Requested explicit per-shape kill switch support after early canary regression report in Slack; add config key like disable_fp8_shapes=[...].
- 2026-02-18 (Yuki): Implemented dispatch hook + config overrides in branch; added golden tests for top hosted model shapes (6 families). Pending review on metric tagging and log format.
- 2026-02-21 (Noah): Review feedback: make fallback reason visible (enum) and ensure baseline path exercised in tests.
- 2026-02-23 (Yuki): Addressed review items; added fallback_reason tag (low-cardinality) and updated docs comments. PR ready for final pass + merge window alignment with runtime-1.22 RC.
